title: Anomaly identity binds assessment context
oracle: Changing the assessment as-of or governance decision changes anomaly identity, so lifecycle events for an older assessment fail closed.
known_bad: Remove the semantic assessment-context snapshot from decision provenance so changed assessments alias to the same anomaly ID.

known_bad_mutation.replace:
context = replace(
        provenance.context,
        config_digest=digest,
        input_snapshot_ids=tuple(
            sorted(ref.evidence_id for ref in _flatten_evidence(evidence_roles))
        ),
    )
